thread.title: Coach Kyle Shanahan's Concussion Affects Brock Purdy's Practice
thread.title_full: Coach Kyle Shanahan's Concussion Affects Brock Purdy's Practice

author: Associated Press
title: Coach Kyle Shanahan's Concussion Affects Brock Purdy's Practice
text:
• Coach Kyle Shanahan suffered a concussion, broken ribs, a broken nose, and a broken hand in a car crash on July 14.
• Purdy typically interacts with Shanahan at meetings and on the practice field.
• Shanahan's role has been given to offensive coordinator Klay Kubiak to start camp.
• Purdy's contact with Shanahan since the crash has been mostly messages about Shanahan's well-being.
• Shanahan watched practice alongside general manager John Lynch for the final 45 minutes.
• Purdy joked about almost hitting Shanahan with an errant deep pass.
• Purdy initially checked with teammate George Kittle to make sure the news about Shanahan was real.
• Purdy focused on Shanahan's health after hearing about the crash.
• Rookie defensive lineman Romello Height was carted off the field after suffering cramps.
• Four other players didn't practice after getting hurt in the first session on Sunday.
• Swing tackle Vederian Lowe has a high ankle sprain and is expected to miss a chunk of training camp.
• Receiver Christian Kirk has a calf strain.
• Rookie DL Gracen Halton has a bruised knee bone.
• DL Andrew Farmer has a back injury.
• Cornerback Nate Hobbs returned to practice after sitting out the first session on Sunday.
summary: That has forced Purdy to adjust as he prepares for year five with the San Francisco 49ers with Shanahan starting training camp as a silent observer at practice rather than an active part of it following a serious car crash that left the coach with a concussion. That role has been given to offensive coordinator Klay Kubiak to start camp this summer as Shanahan recovers from the concussion. Offensive line coach Chris Foerster is running the team in Shanahan's absence with help from coordinators Kubiak, Raheem Morris and Brant Boyer.
